title: Microbial and Fungal Community Dynamics During Process Upgrade in a Two-Stage Anoxic/Oxic (AOAO) Landfill Leachate Treatment System
description: This project investigates the ecological mechanisms underlying microbial and fungal community changes during a full-scale upgrade of a two-stage anoxic/oxic (AOAO) landfill leachate treatment system. Samples were collected from four bioreactors, influent, and supernatant during the transition from conventional nitrification-denitrification (CND) to partial nitrification-denitrification (PND). High-throughput 16S rRNA and ITS1 sequencing was performed to analyze community diversity, functional potential, and pathogen dynamics. The study revealed reactor-specific responses to environmental pressures (e.g., BOD, DO), enhanced nitrogen and sulfur metabolism under PND, suppression of pathogenic taxa, and increased abundance of EPS-producing Chloroflexi in the effluent. This dataset supports the understanding of microbial adaptation and functional shifts in engineered biological systems and offers insights for optimizing landfill leachate treatment.
